body:
maya: Quick pass — the metrics page in dark mode feels a bit washed out. The line charts' blue doesn’t pop against the background. Can we pick a stronger accent or tweak chart surface/bg? cc @sam for accessibility numbers

sam: I ran contrast checks — our current blue (#5B8DEF) on bg #0B1020 is ~2.8:1, too low. For primary metric lines I’d aim for >=4.5:1. For secondary lines >=3:1 is acceptable. Also watch for saturation spikes that cause haloing on OLED. :thinking_face:

jin: Agreed. Proposal: move primary accent to #4BA3FF (4.6:1) and secondary to #2E75C9 (3.2:1). For code blocks and logs, lighten the bg slightly for token legibility. Small CSS tokens we tried locally:
```css
:root {
  --bg: #0B1020;
  --surface: #0F1626;
  --accent-primary: #4BA3FF; /* primary metrics */
  --accent-secondary: #2E75C9; /* tertiary / secondary series */
  --code-bg: #071122;
}
```

alex: I like those swatches. A couple of UX nits: 1) we should avoid using pure-saturated red/green pairs for status lines — colorblind-safe palette needed; 2) chart fills (area under line) should use low-alpha versions so dense charts don't turn into giant blocks.

maya: Good catch on colorblind safety. Sam, do you have a quick colorblind-proof set we can share with analytics?

sam: Yep — suggestion (tested with 2 colorblind simulators): primary #4BA3FF, alt #FFB86B (warm), diff #6EE7B7 (mint). For diverging bars use #FF6B6B (neg), #A3A3FF (neutral), #4BA3FF (pos). Also recommend we default to distinct patterns/hatches for print/export.

helen: One more accessibility nit — axis labels in dark mode are at 3.6:1 with current token. Increase to 4.5:1 or use semi-bold for labels. Small change but huge impact for readers with low vision.

jin: Noted. I’ll update tokens and push a staging preview. Also adjusted syntax highlighting for console so keywords and strings contrast: keywords #B6D7FF, strings #C7F7D6, comments #7E8A99 on code-bg.

ui-bot: Preview deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood-inference.com/dashboards/metrics?theme=dark — snapshot generated.

alex: Quick visual QA: primary metric line looks much better. Two small asks: reduce blue brightness by ~6% at 1440px to avoid bloom; and soften gridlines to #21283a (alpha 30%). Otherwise :thumbsup:.

maya: Thanks all. Jin — can you drop the updated token PR and include the WCAG contrast report link (webaim checker)? Also add a short note in Console -> Theme settings about "High-contrast charts" toggle.

jin: On it — PR after lunch, will include contrast report and colorblind simulator screenshots.

sam: Awesome, thanks. If we still see issues, let's test with a few customer dashboards with dense series.

maya: Perfect. Closing loop — we'll ship on next minor release if staging checks pass. :white_check_mark:
